<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.15pt; text-indent: 57.2pt">1.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>EMPLOYMENT
AND <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.65pt">DUTIES.</FONT></U> Company employs Executive as its Chief Operating Officer
(&ldquo;COO&rdquo;). In his capacity as <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">COO,</FONT> Executive shall report only to the Chief
Executive Officer and the Board of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Directors</FONT> of the Company and Solar and shall be
responsible for each Company&rsquo;s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">day-to-day </FONT>operating activities. The following
conditions shall apply to <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive&rsquo;s </FONT>employment under this Agreement: (i)
Executive shall be permitted to work from home at his <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">discretion; </FONT>(ii) Executive shall
be the Company and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">Solar&rsquo;s </FONT>only COO and no other individual shall hold the
position of COO or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">co-COO; </FONT>(iii)&nbsp;other <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">tha</FONT>n <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">th</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Chie</FONT>f <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Executiv</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Office</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.6pt">r</FONT>, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">n</FONT>o <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">individua</FONT>l <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">ind</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.25pt">i</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">v</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -1.2pt">i</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">ctu</FONT>a <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">l</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">s</FONT>,
whether acting as a committee or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">otherwise, </FONT>shall have executive authority over or equal
to that of the Executive and neither the Company nor Solar shall take any action which would or could have the effect of giving any
individual(s) such authority or which appears to give any <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">individual(s) </FONT>such authority;
(iv) <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">Executive&rsquo;</FONT> s title may not be changed or modified in any way; (v) <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Executive&rsquo;</FONT>
s duties shall not be changed in any way from those he has performed <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">previously, </FONT>nor
shall Executive&rsquo;s duties or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">responsibilities </FONT>be reduced in any way; (vi)
Executive shall devote sufficient time to the performance of his duties as COO of both Company and Solar; (viii) Executive shall be
entitled to the full protection of all applicable indemnification provisions of the Company and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Solar&rsquo;s </FONT>Articles
of Incorporation and bylaws, for his service as a <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">director,</FONT> executive officer and
employee of the Company and Solar.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.4pt 0 5.9pt; text-indent: 0.15pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5pt 0 5.6pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.7pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">If:
</FONT>(i) Company or Solar changes the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive&rsquo;s </FONT>duties and responsibilities as those
duties are set forth in this Section 1 without Executive&rsquo; s consent (including, without limitation, violation of any of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">provisions
</FONT>of clauses (ii)-(v) above; (ii) there occurs a breach by Company or Solar of any of their obligations under this Agreement that
has not been cured in all material respects within ten (10) days after the Executive gives notice thereof to the Company or Solar, as
the case may be; (iii) there occurs a &ldquo;change in control&rdquo; (as that term is defined below) with respect to either Company or
Solar <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">or;</FONT> (iv) the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive</FONT> has not been paid
for a cumulative sixty (60) day period without <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive&rsquo;s </FONT>consent in excess of the
period of non-payment for similar <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executives, </FONT>then Executive shall have the right to terminate
his employment with Company and Solar, but such termination shall not be considered a voluntary resignation or termination of such employment
or of this Employment Agreement by the Executive but rather a discharge of the Executive by the Company and Solar &ldquo;without cause&rdquo;
(as that term is defined <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">below). </FONT>For purposes of this Agreement, the term &ldquo;change in
control&rdquo; means the first to occur of the following events:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5pt 0 5.6pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.7pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.5pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 35.9pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(i)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>any
person or group of commonly controlled persons acquires, directly or indirectly, fifty percent (50%) or more of the voting control or
value of the equity interests in the Company or Solar; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.9pt 0 5.5pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 35.9pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 6.6pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 34.8pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(ii)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>the
shareholders of Company or Solar approving an agreement to merge or consolidate with another corporation or other entity resulting
(whether separately or in connection with a series of transactions) in a change in ownership of fifty percent (50%) or more of the
voting control or value of the equity interests in Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Solar,</FONT> or an agreement to
sell or otherwise dispose of all or substantially all of Company or Solar&rsquo;s assets (including, without limitation, a plan of
liquidation or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">dissolution), </FONT>or otherwise approve of a fundamental alteration in the
nature of the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Solar&rsquo;s </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">business.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.7pt 0 6.6pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 34.8pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.7pt 0 6.6pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 34.8pt"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 57.2pt">2.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;TERM.
The term of this Agreement shall begin on the Effective Date and shall continue through December 31, 2018 (the &ldquo;Initial Term&rdquo;).
Following the expiration of the Initial Term, this Agreement shall <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">automatically</FONT> renew for
successive one (1) year <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">terms,</FONT> up to a maximum of ten (10) additional <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">years,</FONT>
unless either party notifies the other in writing of his or its desire not to renew at least ninety (90) days prior to the expiration
of the then current term.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.35pt 0 9.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 62.65pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 7.25pt 0 5.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 57.2pt">3 .&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <U>COMPENSATION</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 72.6pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(a)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">Base.</FONT>
Throughout the Initial term of this Agreement and for any renewal term, for services rendered under this Agreement, Executive shall be
paid annual base compensation of One Hundred Seventy Five Thousand and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">00/100</FONT> Dollars ($175,000.00)(the
&ldquo;Annual Base Compensation&rdquo;) , payable in accordance with <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Company&rsquo;</FONT> and Solar&rsquo;s
current payroll policies which Company and Solar agree not to change without Executive&rsquo;s written consent.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.5pt 0 8.8pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.25pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Automatic
Increases. </FONT>Annual Base Compensation shall be increased automatically upon the achievement of agreed upon economic milestones and
business development achievements . <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Company, </FONT>Solar and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">Executive
</FONT>agree to negotiate in good faith to establish agreed upon milestones and business development achievements and the failure to do
so <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.45pt">shall</FONT> be considered a breach of this Agreement by Company and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">Solar</FONT>
unless otherwise agreed by <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">Executive.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.05pt 0 8pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.7pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>Discretionary
Increases. Annual Base Compensation may be increased <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">from</FONT> time to time at the discretion of
the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.45pt">Solar&rsquo;s</FONT> Board <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>f <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Dire</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -2.95pt">c</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">t</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">or</FONT>s
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">base</FONT>d <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>n <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">th</FONT>e
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">performanc</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>f <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Executiv</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -4.8pt">e</FONT>,
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Compan</FONT>y <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">an</FONT>d <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Sola</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.75pt">r</FONT>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.75pt 0 7.35pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.6pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(d)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Bonus. </FONT>Executive
shall be eligible to <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">receive</FONT> an annual bonus bonuses based <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.1pt">or </FONT>the
performance <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.15pt">of </FONT>Executive and Company or Solar as on <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">determined </FONT>by
the Board of Directors of the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Solar,</FONT> as the case may <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.45pt">be.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 7.1pt; text-indent: 36.15pt"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(e)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>Accrued
Annual Base Compensation. <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">In</FONT> the event that Executive does <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">not
receive</FONT> payment of any portion of the Annual Base Compensation due <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">t</FONT>o <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Executiv</FONT>e

<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">i</FONT>s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">earne</FONT>d <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.25pt">&ldquo;</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">A</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">ccrue</FONT>d
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Compensatio</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">n</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -6.55pt">&rdquo;</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.45pt">)</FONT>,
Executive shall, at any <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">time </FONT>thereafter have the option, exercisable by delivery of written
notice to Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.45pt">Solar,</FONT> of converting all or any portion of such Accrued Compensation
into a note or notes payable from Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Solar.</FONT> Any such notes payable shall have an
effective date of January 1 of the year following the year in which the Accrued Compensation was earned and the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">note(s)</FONT>
shall otherwise be on the same terms and conditions as are provided for in <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">the</FONT> <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Note.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 7.8pt 0 5.95pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.95pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(f)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>New
Warrants. Contemporaneous with the issuance of any note delivered to Executive in accordance with (3(e)) above, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Solar </FONT>shall
issue <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive</FONT> new Warrants granting Executive the right to purchase shares of Solar
common stock <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">for</FONT> a purchase price per share equal <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">to </FONT>the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">market</FONT>
price as of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">date</FONT> of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">warrant</FONT> plus
twenty percent (20%). The warrant(s) shall provide that Executive may exercise the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">warrants,</FONT>
in <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">whole</FONT> or in <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">part, </FONT>at any time that there
is an outstanding balance due under any note payable by Solar to Executive and shall otherwise contain terms identical to those
provided for in the Warrant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 57.2pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">5.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt"><U>TERMINATION</U>.

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(a)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Deat</U></FONT><U>h <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Long-Ter</FONT>m <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Disabilit</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -5.35pt">y</FONT></U>. <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Executive&rsquo;</FONT>s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">employmen</FONT>t <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">under
thi</FONT>s <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Agreemen</FONT>t <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">shal</FONT>l <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">b</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">terminate</FONT>d <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">upo</FONT>n <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">th</FONT>e <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">deat</FONT>h <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>f <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Executiv</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -4.75pt">e</FONT>. <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Executiv</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -1.8pt">e</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.65pt">&rsquo;</FONT>s
employment under this Agreement may be terminated upon thirty (30) days&rsquo; written notice to Executive if Executive shall be
unable to perform his duties substantially as required by this Agreement by reason of physical or mental disability or incapacity
(from any cause or causes whatsoever) for a period of more than ninety (90) days, whether or not continuous, in any continuous sixty
(120) day <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">period.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 7pt 0 8.95pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.05pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><U>For
Cause.</U> <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive&rsquo;</FONT> s employment under this Agreement may be terminated immediately
by the Company for &ldquo;Cause&rdquo;. For purposes of this Agreement, the term &ldquo;Cause&rdquo; shall mean the existence or occurrence
of one or more of the following conditions or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">events:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.6pt 0 8.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.3pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 7.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.55pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(i)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Executive&rsquo;</FONT>
s commission of willful and intentional acts involving gross misconduct (including , without limitation, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">theft,</FONT>
fraud or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">embezzlement);</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.4pt 0 7.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.55pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 7.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.55pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(ii)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive&rsquo;s
</FONT>conviction <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.1pt">of, </FONT>or plea of guilty or nolo contendere to, a felony or a crime involving
moral turpitude; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.45pt 0 7.65pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.45pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 7.9pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.55pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(iii)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>a
material breach by Executive of any <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">material</FONT> provision of this Agreement or of any contractual
or legal duty to the Company, including, but not limited to, the unauthorized disclosure of confidential information, that remains uncured
after thirty (30) business days following a written notice from the Board of Directors of the Company to <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">cure.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.75pt 0 7.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 72.25pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<U>Withou</U></FONT><U>t
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Caus</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.35pt">e</FONT></U>. <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Executiv</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -4.65pt">e</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.9pt">&rsquo;</FONT>s
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">employmen</FONT>t <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">unde</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">thi</FONT>s
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Agreement </FONT>may be terminated by the Company at any time without Cause upon not less than (30)
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">days&rsquo; </FONT>prior written notice. Any termination of Executive&rsquo;s employment other than
as a result of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Death,</FONT> Long Term Disability or by the Company or Solar for Cause shall be considered
for all purposes of this Agreement to be a termination without cause entitling Executive to severance as provided for in Section 7 <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">below.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.2pt 0 6.6pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(d)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><U>Change
in <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">Control</FONT></U><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">. </FONT>In the event of a Change in
Control (as defined in Section 1 above), Executive may elect, at any time during the ninety (90) day period immediately following such
Change in Control, to deliver thirty (30) <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">days&rsquo;</FONT> written notice to the Company and Solar
of his termination of employment under this <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Agreement. </FONT>Such termination shall be deemed to
be a termination without cause for all purposes of this Agreement entitling Executive to Severance as provided under Section 7.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.55pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 57.2pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">6.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><U>SEVERANCE.
- TERMINATION RESULTING FROM DEATH, DISABILITY OR FOR CAUSE</U> . In the event <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive&rsquo;s </FONT>employment
under this Agreement is terminated in connection with <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive&rsquo;</FONT> s death or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">long-term</FONT>
disability or by Company for <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Cause, </FONT>Company shall pay Executive (or in the case of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">death, </FONT>his
heirs or personal representatives), within thirty (30) days after the effective date of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">termination,
Executive&rsquo;s </FONT>Annual Base Compensation and benefits and all expenses payable under Section 4 above through such date of
death or termination, and Company shall have no further obligation to provide compensation or benefits to Executive under this
Agreement; <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">provided, </FONT>however, that to the extent that any of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Company&rsquo;s </FONT>benefit
plans provide rights or benefits after termination, Executive may continue to receive such rights or benefits in accordance with the
terms of such <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.45pt">plans.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 57.2pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">10.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><U>CONFIDENTIALITY. </U>Executive
recognizes and acknowledges that he will have access to certain confidential information of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Company, </FONT>Solar
and of entities with whom Company and Solar do <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">business, </FONT>and that such information
constitutes <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.55pt">valuable,</FONT> special and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">unique</FONT>
property of the Company and Solar and such other entities. During the Term of this Agreement and for a period of two (2) years
immediately following the date of termination of this <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.45pt">Agreement,</FONT> Executive agrees not
to disclose or use any confidential information, including without limitation, information concerning the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Solar&rsquo;s </FONT>financial
condition , research and development activities, technologies, product designs and/or specifications, <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">&ldquo;know-how;&rdquo; </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">prices,
customers,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">prospects,</FONT> methods of doing <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">business, </FONT>marketing
and promotional activities, or any information or knowledge with respect to confidential information or trade secrets of the company
or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Solar,</FONT> it being understood that such confidential information does not include
information that is publicly available unless such information became publicly available as a result of a breach of this Agreement.
Executive acknowledges and agrees that all <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">notes, </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">records, </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">reports, </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">sketches,
plans, </FONT>unpublished memoranda or other documents belonging to the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Solar,</FONT>
but held by <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive,</FONT> concerning any information relating to the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">Solar&rsquo;s
business, </FONT>whether confidential or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">not, </FONT>are the property of the Company and Solar
and will be promptly delivered to it upon <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Executive&rsquo;s </FONT>leaving the employ of the
Company and Solar. Executive also agrees to execute such confidentiality agreements that the Board of Directors may adopt, and may
modify from time to <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">time,</FONT> as a standard form to be executed by all executive employees
of the Company or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">Solar, </FONT>to the extent such standard forms are not more restrictive than
the provisions of this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.15pt 0 5.55pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.15pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 7.55pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 35.65pt">The restrictions
set forth in this Section are considered to be reasonable for the purposes of protecting the business of Company and Solar. <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Company,</FONT>
Solar and Executive acknowledge that Company and Solar would be irreparably harmed and that monetary damages would not provide an adequate
remedy to the Company if the covenants contained in this Section were not complied with in accordance with its <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">terms.
Accordingly,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">Executive</FONT> agrees that Company and Solar shall be entitled to injunctive
and other equitable relief to secure the enforcement of these <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">provisions,</FONT> in addition to any
other remedy which may be available to the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Company. </FONT>Any legal action commenced by the Company
or Solar to secure the enforcement of this Section shall be commenced in Montgomery County , Maryland . The prevailing party in any such
legal action shall be entitled to receive from the other party reimbursement for the reasonable attorneys&rsquo; fees and expenses incurred
by the prevailing <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">party.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5pt 0 7.55pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 35.65pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 32.6pt">The provisions of Section shall survive
the termination of this Agreement, regardless of the circumstances or reasons for such termination, and inure to the benefit of the Company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 5.15pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 57.2pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">12.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><U>DISPUTES.</U>
Except as provided in the next <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">paragraph, </FONT>in the event that a dispute arises between Executive
and Company or Solar concerning any matter under this Agreement, such dispute shall be resolved through binding arbitration which shall
be conducted before three (3) impartial <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">arbitrators. </FONT>One arbitrator shall be selected by each
party and the two arbitrators who are so selected shall select the third arbitrator. Any such arbitration shall be held in Montgomery
County, Maryland . The arbitrators shall reach a decision in the arbitration based on the facts of the matter and applicable law. The
Arbitrators decision shall be final and binding on the parties and enforceable in a court of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.3pt">law.</FONT>
Company and Solar shall pay all costs and fees in connection with the arbitration.</P>

Prior Agreement which is terminated and shall be of no further effect. No future oral <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">statements, </FONT>promises
or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">commitments </FONT>with respect to the subject matter <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">hereof, </FONT>or
other purported modification hereof, shall be binding upon the parties hereto unless the same is reduced to writing and signed by
each party hereto.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 8.4pt 0 5pt; text-indent: 0.35pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>The
rights and obligations of Company and Solar under this Agreement shall inure to <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">the </FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">benefit
</FONT>of and shall be binding upon the successors and assigns of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Company.</FONT> Executive <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.05pt">may</FONT>
not assign his rights and obligations under this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 12.1pt 0 5.2pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.95pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 12.1pt 0 5.2pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.95pt"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 8 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 12.1pt 0 5.2pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.95pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>This
Agreement shall be subject to and governed by the laws of the State of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">Maryland,</FONT> without regard
to the conflicts of laws principles thereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.3pt 0 12.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.6pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(d)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>The
section headings contained <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt"></FONT>herein are <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">for </FONT>reference
purposes only and shall <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.4pt">not </FONT>in <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt"></FONT>any way affect
the meaning or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">the&lsquo;interpretation </FONT>of this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 12.2pt; text-indent: 36.45pt"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(e)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>The
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">failure </FONT>of any party to enforce any provision of this Agreement shall in no manner affect
the right to enforce the same, and the waiver by any party of any breach of any provision of this Agreement shall not be construed to
be a waiver by such party of any succeeding <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">breach</FONT> of such provision or a waiver by such
party of any breach of any other provision.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.9pt 0 11.35pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.6pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(f)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT>In
the event any one or more of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">provisions</FONT> of this Agreement shall for any reason be held
invalid, illegal or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">unenforceable, </FONT>the remaining <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">provisions
</FONT>of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.15pt">this </FONT>Agreement shall be <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">unimpaired, </FONT>and
the invalid, illegal or unenforceable provision shall be replaced by a mutually acceptable valid, and enforceable provision which comes
closest to the intent of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.35pt">parties.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.35pt 0 10.75pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.85pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(g)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Thi</FONT>s
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">Agreemen</FONT>t <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">ma</FONT>y <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">b</FONT>e
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">execute</FONT>d <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">i</FONT>n <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">an</FONT>y
<FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">numbe</FONT>r <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">o</FONT>f <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">counterpart</FONT><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -4.3pt">s</FONT>,
each of which shall constitute an original and all of which together <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">shall </FONT>constitute one
and the same instrument.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.55pt 0 10.1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36.4pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 32.85pt">The parties
have executed this Employment Agreement as of the day and year first above written.</P>
